title: Floating dandelion seed
prompt: Create a picture (generate an image, do not reply with text): A single dandelion seed floating through the air for a cute mobile game, on a fully transparent background. A big poofy, feathery white parachute of fine radiating wisps shaped like a soft open umbrella, with a tiny tan seed and a very short wisp underneath it (no long stem or tail), slightly tilted as if drifting on the breeze. Light, airy and fluffy. Chunky, clean cartoon game-art style with a thick dark-brown outline, matching the rest of the monthly emoji set. No text, no background. Square 1:1 ratio.
